name: Rhythm Boxing: Padwork
summary:
Step into the ring. Find your rhythm.

Rhythm Boxing: Padwork is an immersive VR boxing trainer that puts you face-to-face with iconic fighting styles. No opponents. No damage bars. Just you, the pads, and the art of combination punching.

Train Your Way

Hand Tracking — Ditch the controllers. Train with just your hands for a natural, comfortable workout, or level up with weighted boxing dumbbells for added resistance.
